title: GreenFaaS: Carbon-Aware Scheduling for Serverless Workloads
description: Reference implementation and discrete-event simulator for GreenFaaS, a carbon-aware scheduler for serverless (FaaS) workloads. Version 1.2.0 corrects the simulator's energy model (warm/cold resolved at start, all warm-idle time charged, newest-first container reuse) and regenerates all results; results from the earlier model are kept under results/legacy_v1.1.0. See CHANGELOG.md.
